legal.privacy.callout: Your data about the shop, products, customers and sales belongs to you. We do not sell it and do not use it for advertising.
legal.privacy.intro: This policy explains what data Stockwise collects, how it is used and what rights you have. It applies to the application and the public shop catalog.
legal.privacy.s1Body: The data controller is {operator}. For all questions about data processing and exercising your rights, contact {email}.
legal.privacy.s2Body: We collect the following categories of data:
legal.privacy.s2b1: Account data — name, email and the identifier of the Google account you use to sign in.
legal.privacy.s2b2: Shop data — name, currency, products, stock, suppliers, categories and catalog settings.
legal.privacy.s2b3: Customer and sales data — names, phone numbers, addresses and the order and sales history you enter yourself.
legal.privacy.s2b4: Technical data — local app settings (language, theme) and the technical data required for sign-in.
legal.privacy.s3Body: We use the data solely to provide the service: displaying and syncing your records, handling orders from the public catalog, showing analytics and storing settings. We do not make automated decisions about you or process data for advertising inside the app.
legal.privacy.s4Body: We process data based on the contract (providing the service), your consent (e.g. the public catalog) and legitimate interest (security and abuse prevention). Customer data you enter is controlled by you; we store it on your behalf.
legal.privacy.s5Body: We share data only with providers of essential technical services: Google Firebase (authentication and database), Cloudinary (product and logo images), Groq (AI suggestions receive the product data you enter) and the site hosting provider. We never sell data or share it for marketing purposes.
legal.privacy.s6Body: We keep data for as long as the account is active. When you delete your account or shop, the data is permanently removed from our database. Details about cookies are described on the Cookies page.
legal.privacy.s7Body2: For requests concerning a shop's customers, contact the seller you bought from — the seller controls that data.
legal.privacy.s7b1: access the data stored about you,
legal.privacy.s7b3: delete your account and all data (deletion is available in the app itself),
legal.privacy.s7b4: receive your data in a readable format,
legal.privacy.s7b5: object and lodge a complaint with a data protection authority.
legal.privacy.s8Body: Data is stored on Google Firebase infrastructure with database-rule access control: only members of a shop can access its data. We apply reasonable technical measures, but no system is completely secure.
legal.privacy.s9Body: We may update this policy from time to time. We announce significant changes in the app. Continuing to use the service after a change means you accept the new version.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.terms.callout: Stockwise is a record-keeping tool. It is not a payment system — catalog orders are merely notifications to the seller.
legal.terms.intro: These terms govern the use of the Stockwise application and the public shop catalog. By accepting them you confirm that you have read and agree to them.
legal.terms.t10Body: You may delete your account at any time in settings. Deletion permanently removes your data in accordance with the Privacy Policy. We reserve the right to temporarily or permanently deny access in case of abuse.
legal.terms.t11Body: These terms are governed by the law of the Republic of Serbia. Contact: {operator}, {email}.
legal.terms.t1Body: By using the application, signing in or creating a shop you accept these terms. If you disagree, do not use the service.
legal.terms.t2Body: Stockwise enables keeping records of products, stock, customers, orders and sales, a public shop catalog and analytics. The service is informational and record-keeping in nature and does not process payments.
legal.terms.t3Body: Sign-in is available with a Google account. You are responsible for the accuracy of the data, the security of your Google account and all activity on your account. The shop owner manages membership and settings.
legal.terms.t4b1: enter unlawful, misleading or offensive content,
legal.terms.t4b2: attempt unauthorized access to other people's data or disrupt the service,
legal.terms.t4b3: automatically scrape data or abuse the public catalog,
legal.terms.t4b4: use the service to sell prohibited products or conduct deceptive sales.
legal.terms.t5Body: All data you enter (products, customers, orders, sales) belongs to you. You are the controller of your customers' data and responsible for the lawfulness of its collection. Stockwise stores and processes it on your behalf in accordance with the Privacy Policy.
legal.terms.t6Body: If you enable the public catalog, your products and selected shop data will be publicly visible. Orders sent by customers are informational — they do not constitute a concluded purchase contract and no payments are processed.
legal.terms.t7Body: We strive for uninterrupted operation but do not guarantee one hundred percent availability. We may change or temporarily suspend the service for maintenance, of which we will notify you in due time.
legal.terms.t8Body: The application, its design and code remain our property. Your data remains yours. We use your shop name and logos solely for display inside the catalog you have enabled.
legal.terms.t9Body: The service is provided as is. We are not liable for inaccurate entries, business decisions based on the displays, data loss due to force majeure or indirect damages. We are obliged to keep your data with reasonable care.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Use
